_comment: Copy to budget-guard.config.json and edit. Every dollar figure here is a LIST-PRICE ESTIMATE computed from the token usage in your harness's own transcript. If you are on a subscription plan, no invoice matches it -- it is a proportional signal and a ceiling, not an accounting record.
_comment_pricing: Per-million-token published rates, verified 2026-08-12. Replace with your contracted rates if you have them. Cache rates are derived from the input rate by cache_multipliers below.
_comment_cache: Fixed ratios of the input rate. A long agent session is mostly cache reads -- pricing them at the full input rate overstates cost by roughly 10x and makes any ceiling meaningless.
_comment_unknown: What to charge for a model ID missing from the table -- which is what a newly released model looks like from here. 'priciest' bills it at your highest configured rate so it over-reports rather than silently costing zero. 'ignore' charges nothing and is a bad default for a spend control.
_comment_ceilings: USD. null disables a ceiling. Crossing one blocks the pending tool call; it does not kill the session, so the agent can still write its summary.
_comment_loop: consecutive_repeats blocks the Nth identical call in a row. The window rule blocks max_repeats occurrences of the same call inside the last `window` calls even when they are not back to back -- a stuck agent usually alternates A,B,A,B, so a consecutive-only check misses the common case. Set either to 0 to disable that rule alone.
